### Bug Fixes
- **agenda:** empty Agenda's own menu when it lets its month go - **switch:** clear the shortcut's error as soon as the tap starts - **switch:** give each focus tracking start its own event stream - **dictate:** close the microphone when fn is let go of during startup (WH-127) - **switch:** check for a newer session again before the repair raise (WH-126) - **dictate:** leave a newer start's microphone open when an old one downloads (WH-127) - **history:** read again a kind whose read failed, with any change (WH-127) - **agenda:** look up calendar apps again after launches, quits and a while (WH-127) - **agenda:** drop the reminder's second line, which the Join button already says - **dictate:** open the microphone while the engine gets ready (WH-127) - **agenda:** open the month without a focus ring on its first arrow (WH-131) - **menubar:** keep the menu at its chosen width under a wide item (WH-131) - **notifications:** leave the reopen alone after a notification button - **agenda:** open the calendar app for a reminder whose meeting is gone - **updater:** let the whole slot take a click while the button has no circle (WH-124) - **updater:** forget "up to date" once an update is found (WH-124) - **updater:** keep an update on offer when installing it fails (WH-124) - **updater:** keep a retried download on offer while Sparkle is busy (WH-124) - **notifications:** keep a handled notification click from opening the main window
### Performance
